dedupe_keys.name: benchmark dataset of cropland parcel boundaries from multi source remote sensing imagery for ai netherlands denmark spain and china

description: A standardised deep learning dataset of cropland parcel labels drawn on multi-source imagery from four countries: the Netherlands, Denmark, Spain and China. The Science Data Bank and Zenodo DataCite records say it holds more than 140,000 parcels with average sizes from 0.05 to 10 hectares across study areas, and that the imagery comes from more than 10 sources, including satellites, drones and public mapping platforms, at 0.05 to 10 m resolution. The Science Data Bank release (version 2, updated 17 November 2025) holds 36 downloadable files of about 35.6 GB under CC BY-NC-SA 4.0; a Zenodo release of 23 November 2024 under CC BY 4.0 and MIT now returns "gone" from the Zenodo API, so the Science Data Bank copy is the one to use. Coverage is study areas in four countries. Caveats: the study areas and file formats are not described in the metadata read, and the non-commercial licence limits reuse. For simulation it trains models that map field boundaries, which give the farm asset layer for crop exposure to floods and droughts and for rural logistics. Related catalogue records include GloCAB cropland field boundaries and NECCPB-1 Northeast China cropland parcels.
